title: Amplitude-envelope cycle variability does not establish incremental cross-cohort prediction of breathing irregularity
abstract: PPG amplitude-envelope cycle-interval CV did not establish incremental cross-cohort prediction of annotated breath-interval CV. BIDMC-trained models tested on CapnoBase had baseline/augmented record-equal MSE 0.0274075/0.0274068, gain 0.0000007 [-0.0006600, 0.0004205]; reverse transfer gave 0.0121839/0.0129572, gain -0.0007733 [-0.0017781, 0.0001250]. Both paired target-record bootstrap 95% intervals included zero. Forward MAE improved modestly, but reverse MAE did not establish benefit. This is an exploratory negative test of a fixed feature, not evidence that PPG contains no breathing-variability information.
